sources.fact: Unit.After and Unit.Before both use config_parse_unit_deps.
Parsed file dependency calls unit_add_dependency_by_name with add_reference=true.
add_reference inserts UNIT_REFERENCES from declaring unit to target.

implication: Declare the reference on the existing active timer pointing to the diagnostic service. Adding inverse Before only inside the diagnostic would reference the timer in the wrong ownership direction for this purpose.
